newsitem.title: USA: Fed shifts Beige Book to later release time.
newsitem.headline: Fed shifts Beige Book to later release time.

text.p: The Federal Reserve's periodic survey of national economic conditions, known as the Beige Book, is being shifted to a 1400 EST (1900 GMT) release time beginning in January, a Fed spokesman said on Monday.
The summary, based on reports from the 12 regional Fed banks, has been issued in the past at 1200 EST (1700 GMT).
The Fed spokesman said it was being moved back for the benefit of traders who complained its release occurred during their bidding in quarterly Treasury refunding auctions.

The Fed's assessment of economic conditions, which often includes comments on wage and price rises as well as on consumer spending and the manufacturing pace, potentially have strong market impact because they are used by the policy-setting Federal Open Market Committee at its meetings to to plot interest-rate strategy.
The next Beige Book is scheduled for release on Jan. 22 and the FOMC meets on Feb. 4-5.
